column1: # Rules for adding: the name must be one people actually say
# THAT object rather than the region around it. An earlier draft of this file
# called Sh2-131 the "Elephant's Trunk Nebula" — Sh2-131 is the whole 170' IC

# because a common name outranks size in identify_target.

# cannot be ANNOTATED — a label needs sky coordinates
# where those come from — but `common_name_for` reads this file directly
# the name still reaches the Share title plate. That is how M 45 and IC 1396A
